title: Entry
description: One transcript entry as the platform read it. The companion NEVER composes an entry: it maps the platform's bounded read one to one, so nothing here is the companion's opinion.

cursor.description: Opaque position, ordered by the platform. A brief's delta is (sinceCursor, throughCursor].

kind.description: KNOWN values: message, tool_line, tombstone, summary. A summary is the platform's own text standing for earlier messages (a header line saying what it covers and how to read them, then the summary), or one sentence saying earlier messages are not shown; it arrives on an opener, authored by the platform. 🔴 Deliberately NOT an enum. Forward compatibility is a requirement of this wire: a reader that meets a kind it does not know renders the entry as a labelled line rather than failing, which is how the summary kind arrived with no version bump. Closing this enum would make the next new kind a breaking change.

text.description: Already flattened and bounded by the platform.

label.description: Display label as the platform resolved it.

handle.description: An agent's @slug, so the model can address it by name.

self.description: True when this entry is the answering agent's own. A delta OMITS these; an opener INCLUDES them.
